---
title: "Before the day"
---

Before the day, install R and the workspace, work through the first module on R, and read the background page. The day assumes that a linear model and its output are not new to you.

## 1. R and the workspace {#the-workspace}

[Install R and an IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Download the workspace]({{< var cases.europeanisation.workspace-zip >}}){.btn .btn-primary}

Install R, Quarto and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) by the steps of the setup page of the AR4DS site, and download the workspace of the case study.

{{< include ../../_includes/_workspace.qmd >}}

The [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) lists the problems that other participants have met. If the installation fails, tell the facilitator before the day.

## 2. Getting started with R

[Open Getting started with R](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work through the module, whose blocks of code run in your browser.

## 3. Background {#the-case-study}

[Read the background](../../background.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The background page presents the claim on which the day works and the five reanalyses of it in the robustness study of SCORE (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026).

## 4. The deck and the browser lab

[Open the deck at Task 1](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-1-get-yourself-running){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The deck used on the day and the browser lab run R inside your browser, and they are the fallback if your installation fails. Open the deck once on the machine and in the browser that you will use, wait until the cells on its slide of the setup check show a "Run Code" button, and run them. If they run, and the second reports 270 rows, 27 countries and 10 years, you are set. If the deck does not load, try the browser lab or another browser, and tell the facilitator before the day.

## 5. Further preparation

Optional readings: the first sections of [Panel data](../../companion/panel-data.qmd#sec-aggregation), from the country-year level to clustered standard errors, [the reading on inference](../../curve.qmd#inference) of the Specification curve page for Part 4, and [the readings on preregistration](../../resources.qmd#preregistration) on the Resources page for Task 5. The modules on [the IDE (Positron and other IDEs)](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html), on [Quarto documents](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html) and on [Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html) take the tools of the workspace further.

## 6. On the day

Bring a laptop with the workspace working on it, and its charger. The day needs no account of any kind, whether for Git and GitHub, the OSF, a data archive or an AI assistant, and every tool that it uses is free.
